001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 214,
009    displayName = "CGM Stop Session GX",
010    internalName = "LID_CGM_STOP_SESSION_GX"
011)
012public class CgmStopSessionHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
013
014    private long currentTransmitterTime;
015    private long sessionStartTime;
016    private long sessionStopTime;
017    private int sessionStopReasonRaw;
018    private int sessionDuration;
019
020    public CgmStopSessionHistoryLog() {}
021    public CgmStopSessionHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
022        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
023    }
024
025    public CgmStopSessionHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int sessionStopReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
026        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
027        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionStopTime, sessionStopReasonRaw, sessionDuration);
028        this.currentTransmitterTime = currentTransmitterTime;
029        this.sessionStartTime = sessionStartTime;
030        this.sessionStopTime = sessionStopTime;
031        this.sessionStopReasonRaw = sessionStopReasonRaw;
032        this.sessionDuration = sessionDuration;
033    }
034
035    public CgmStopSessionHistoryLog(long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int sessionStopReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
036        this(0, 0, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionStopTime, sessionStopReasonRaw, sessionDuration);
037    }
038
039    public int typeId() {
040        return 214;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * <table border="1">
045     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmStopSessionHistoryLog:</caption>
046     * <tr><td><code>currentTransmitterTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
047     * <tr><td><code>sessionStartTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
048     * <tr><td><code>sessionStopTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
049     * <tr><td><code>sessionStopReasonRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
050     * <tr><td><code>sessionDuration</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
051     * </table>
052     */
053    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
054        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
055        this.cargo = raw;
056        parseBase(raw);
057        this.currentTransmitterTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
058        this.sessionStartTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
059        this.sessionStopTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
060        this.sessionStopReasonRaw = raw[24] & 0xFF;
061        this.sessionDuration = raw[25] & 0xFF;
062
063    }
064
065    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
066        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
067    }
068
069    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int sessionStopReasonRaw, int sessionDuration) {
070        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
071            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(214, 0),
072            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
073            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
074            Bytes.toUint32(currentTransmitterTime),
075            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStartTime),
076            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStopTime),
077            new byte[]{0, 0},
078            new byte[]{(byte) sessionStopReasonRaw},
079            new byte[]{(byte) sessionDuration}));
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * @return the current transmitter time, in seconds
084     */
085    public long getCurrentTransmitterTime() {
086        return currentTransmitterTime;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * @return the session start time, in seconds
091     */
092    public long getSessionStartTime() {
093        return sessionStartTime;
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * @return the session stop time, in seconds
098     */
099    public long getSessionStopTime() {
100        return sessionStopTime;
101    }
102
103    public int getSessionStopReasonRaw() {
104        return sessionStopReasonRaw;
105    }
106
107    public enum SessionStopReason {
108        DEXBLES_REASON_USER(0),
109        DEXBLES_REASON_UNKNOWN(1),
110        DEXBLES_REASON_TX_END_OF_LIFE(3),
111        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_ERROR(4),
112        DEXBLES_REASON_SESSION_STOP_SUCCESS(5),
113        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_NOT_IN_SESSION(6),
114        DEXBLES_REASON_NEW_SESSION_STARTED_SUCCESS(8),
115        DEXBLES_REASON_SESSION_STARTED_IN_PROGRESS(9),
116        DEXBLES_REASON_TRANSMITTER_IN_SESSION(10),
117        DEXBLES_REASON_BLESTACK_INVALID(11),
118        DEXBLES_REASON_NEW_AUTOCAL_SESSION_STARTED_SUCCESS(12),
119        DEXBLES_REASON_NO_AUTOCAL_SESSION_IN_PROGRESS(13),
120
121        ;
122        private int id;
123        SessionStopReason(int id) {
124            this.id = id;
125        }
126
127        public static SessionStopReason fromId(int id) {
128            for (SessionStopReason r : values()) {
129                if (r.id == id) {
130                    return r;
131                }
132            }
133            return null;
134        }
135
136        public int getId() {
137            return id;
138        }
139    }
140
141    public SessionStopReason getSessionStopReason() {
142        return SessionStopReason.fromId(sessionStopReasonRaw);
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * @return the session duration, in days
147     */
148    public int getSessionDuration() {
149        return sessionDuration;
150    }
151}
